preconditions.description: The number of nodes n and distance limit d satisfy the given bounds.
There are exactly n-1 edges defining the tree structure.
The number of required nodes for each piece is within valid bounds.
The sequences of nodes for both pieces contain distinct elements.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: All edge endpoints are valid node indices.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n for x in a) and all(1 <= x <= n for x in b)
preconditions.description: All target nodes in the sequences are valid node indices.

postconditions.description: The output is a non-negative integer representing the minimum steps.

The output equals the minimum total steps required to visit all nodes in sequence a and sequence b, starting and ending at node 1, while maintaining the distance between the two pieces at most d at all times.
